prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Sentinel Vale ground excludes spacecraft/launch/external-processing. Mission Control Center(Bluebell:local-voice-only) authorizes/routes; receives User Services Portal requests; sends constraints to Mission Planning System(Cedar), which screens/schedules and produces command preparation package. Ground Network Manager(Juniper:standing-rosters) confirms maintenance. Contacts: North S-Band Antenna/South S-Band Antenna/Kiruna X-Band Antenna/Svalbard X-Band Antenna. Command Validation Gateway(Osprey) independently validates/rejects stacks against screened burns; planning/release segregated; Mission Control Center/Spacecraft Operations Team concur before uplink. Cybersecurity Desk reviews exceptions. Faults: preserve command-state; prohibit discretionary commands; specialist-review reconfiguration. Spacecraft Operations Team assesses Antenna Deicing Notice/receives maneuver recommendation package. Orbit Determination Engine produces qualified orbital solution/Doppler Residual Report/Laser Retroreflector Window. Product Quality Service checks orbital quality. Flight Dynamics Team screens maneuvers/conjunctions, produces Ephemeris Delta Note. Flight Dynamics Facility(Mistral:legacy-shift-logs) supplies Star Tracker Mask File/controlled ephemerides/events. Bluebell deliveries require validity/frame/generation-time/use-statement. Network Control System uses accepted-ephemeris pointing. Telemetry Ingest Service validates manifested telemetry/files, supplies health/configuration/interruption metadata/Pass Replay Packet; immutable session-tagged raw staging; isolate corruption and expose disposition. Payload Processing Facility(Forgehouse:consoles/shift-logs) coordinates processing. Primary Processing Cluster: Level 0 ordered/deframed packets, preserved times/no corrections; Level 1A detectors/context; Level 1B radiometric application. Every level records software-build/calibration-baseline/ancillary versions. Payload Calibration Team receives geometry, maintains approved baseline/reviews trends. Sample-test changes against baseline; changed scale/alignment/saturation require specification updates before release. Product Quality Service receives patch bundle; updates applicability; flags missing-packets/timing/saturation/cloud/geolocation/fallback in metadata/summaries; produces Product Hold List. Failed mandatory checks/missing ancillary/blocking reviews cause reproducible staging hold; clear before delivery. Network Control System uses Security Exception Ticket to restrict paths until containment approved/completed. Lantern(alias unresolved) preserves validated routing/rejects unreviewed changes during transfers. Scheduling service assigns eligible overflow to Backup Processing Cluster with identical image/rules; fallback provenance informs quality. Both unavailable:

New part:
S176: Recovery after suspension prioritizes products with contractual latency commitments, then processes remaining scenes in acquisition order unless mission management approves a different backlog rule.
S177: Long Term Archive is the authoritative repository for Sentinel Vale raw downlink, auxiliary data, processing inputs, generated products, and operational metadata after routine production has completed.
S178: Archive admission begins only after Payload Processing Facility has delivered the product package, associated quality metadata, and checksum evidence required by the configured acceptance rule.
S179: Each accepted object is assigned a persistent identifier that remains stable across media migration, catalogue refresh, and later reprocessing campaigns.
S180: The repository stores object content separately from searchable metadata so that catalogue publication can proceed without exposing internal storage paths.
S181: Catalogue records are published to User Services Portal after Product Quality Service has set the public quality status and the embargo rule has been evaluated.
S182: Products under operational review remain discoverable only to authorized mission staff until the release condition is cleared.
S183: User Services Portal provides search, preview, order, and download functions through a browser interface and documented machine interfaces.
S184: Download services support resumable transfer, integrity verification, and rate controls that protect mission operations from excessive external demand.
S185: Registered users receive authorization scopes based on mission policy, contractual access rights, and applicable data licensing constraints.
S186: Anonymous access is allowed only for product classes that have been approved for open dissemination by mission management.
S187: Long Term Archive retains raw acquisition data for the life of the mission and for the post-mission preservation period defined in the archive policy.
S188: Standard Level 1 and Level 2 products are retained online while demand, contractual latency, or reprocessing dependence justifies low-latency access.
S189: Older product copies may be moved to lower-cost storage when catalogue metadata, checksums, and restore procedures remain available.
S190: Deletion is performed only against superseded temporary products, expired working copies, or objects covered by an approved disposal rule.
S191: Retention exceptions require traceability to the approving authority, the affected product classes, and the expected operational impact.
S192: Reprocessing is triggered when calibration improvements, processor corrections, orbit updates, or quality investigations materially change product fitness for use.
S193: Payload Calibration Team may request a reprocessing campaign when validation evidence shows a systematic radiometric or geometric issue.
S194: Mistral publishes orbit quality state changes to the archive operations queue before catalogue validity flags are updated.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
